_meta.description: Pre-registered strategy candidates for TradingView Strategy Report tests. These are hypotheses, not recommendations or claimed results.
_meta.platform_validation_reason: This repository has no authenticated TradingView chart session and no Pine compiler. The code has been statically reviewed only; no Strategy Report export was available.
_meta.independent_simulation_note: Run by scripts/run_backtests.py (engine intel-1) on committed vendor daily bars; platform_validation_status stays not_run because no TradingView Strategy Report exists.

models.name: Donchian trend breakout
models.hypothesis: A close beyond the prior channel, filtered by moving-average direction and ATR expansion, captures persistent one-way moves better than an unfiltered breakout.
models.entry_logic: Long above the prior Donchian high when the fast EMA is above the slow EMA and ATR exceeds its baseline; short below the prior Donchian low under the opposite trend condition.
models.exit_logic: Opposite signal, optional ATR bracket, or the configured test-window end.
models.contest_fit: Tests directional expansion in either direction and realizes P/L on reversal instead of assuming a known market direction.
models.falsification_rule: Reject if walk-forward median net profit is not positive, if the lower confidence bound is not positive, or if results depend on one symbol or one window.

result.basis: independent daily-bar simulation (intel engine; NOT a TradingView Strategy Report)

models.name: EMA impulse continuation
models.hypothesis: A fast/slow EMA crossover accompanied by above-baseline ATR identifies momentum transitions that persist long enough to overcome modeled costs.
models.entry_logic: Long on a fast EMA cross above the slow EMA during ATR expansion; short on the inverse cross.
models.exit_logic: Opposite signal, optional ATR bracket, or the configured test-window end.
models.contest_fit: Produces fewer, explicit direction changes than a bar-by-bar ranking heuristic and can be compared across every eligible futures chart.
models.falsification_rule: Reject if out-of-sample net profit is non-positive after costs or if performance reverses under nearby EMA lengths.

models.name: Bollinger squeeze release
models.hypothesis: A close outside the Bollinger envelope after bandwidth compression captures volatility expansion without predicting whether the break will be up or down.
models.entry_logic: Long above the upper band or short below the lower band when prior bandwidth was near its rolling minimum and current bandwidth expands.
models.exit_logic: Opposite signal, optional ATR bracket, or the configured test-window end.
models.contest_fit: Directly tests a compression-to-expansion mechanism rather than labeling an asset volatile from its name or asset class.
models.falsification_rule: Reject if out-of-sample profit is non-positive, trade count is too small for the declared confidence interval, or small parameter changes erase the result.
